name: skills
title_zh: 把 Matt Pocock 的 .agents 目录
tagline_zh: 你写代码时卡在类型报错、重构犹豫、测试漏网？这里是他本人调教过的 skill，从真实提交里长出来。
tagline_en: Stuck on type errors, refactors, or blind spots? These are skills Matt actually runs in his own .agents — grown.
desc_en: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
why_zh: 不是包装过的教程，是他仓库里正在用的原文件。装完即得他处理 TS 边界、提交信息、代码评审时的判断路径。
why_en: Not a curated tutorial — raw skills from his live .agents directory. You inherit his actual decision paths for TS edge cases.
limit_zh: 只覆盖他个人工作流覆盖到的场景（TypeScript、短提交、PR 评审）。不含通用脚手架或框架无关的万能 agent。
limit_en: Only covers his personal workflow (TS, short commits, PR review). No generic scaffolding. Outputs carry his taste — may clash with your team's.
title_en: Drop Matt Pocock's .agents skills into your repo
